question: Should `scripts/check-workflows.mjs` make five minutes a non-configurable hard deadline for every existing external validation and fallback command?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically focused and has real POSIX and Windows timeout evidence, but the acceptable duration for legitimate dependency/bootstrap work is a repository workflow policy decision rather than something tests can establish.

options.title: Accept the fixed deadline
options.body: Merge with the five-minute non-configurable limit and treat commands exceeding it as unsupported for the local workflow-sanity path.

options.title: Narrow the timeout policy
options.body: Apply bounded execution only to the commands known to hang, or choose per-command limits based on their established runtime expectations.

options.title: Pause for runtime data
options.body: Collect representative slow-path timings before changing the failure contract for fallback and bootstrap commands.

recommendation.title: Accept the fixed deadline
recommendation.body: Merge with the five-minute non-configurable limit and treat commands exceeding it as unsupported for the local workflow-sanity path.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contributor connected to the proposed timeout design; a current-main scripts owner should make the final policy call.
